challenges.title: Skip Single-Use Plastic
challenges.question: What is the best way to avoid a single-use drink bottle?

options.text: Carry a reusable water bottle
Use a new plastic bottle each time
Recycle a disposable cup after every drink

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! A reusable bottle helps prevent single-use waste.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Carrying a reusable water bottle avoids single-use waste.

challenges.title: Beat the Heat
challenges.question: Which action saves the most energy when cooling your home?

options.text: Set the AC to 18°C
Set the AC around 24–26°C
Keep the windows open while the AC is running

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Setting the AC around 24–26°C saves energy.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Setting the AC around 24–26°C saves energy.

challenges.title: Save Every Drop
challenges.question: What is a simple way to reduce water waste while brushing your teeth?

options.text: Leave the tap running
Use hot water the whole time
Turn off the tap while brushing

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Turning off the tap saves water.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Turn off the tap while brushing to avoid wasting water.

challenges.title: Sort Your Waste
challenges.question: How should clean paper and cardboard usually be disposed of?

options.text: Put them with recyclable dry waste
Mix them with food scraps
Burn them outdoors

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Keep clean paper and cardboard separate for recycling.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Clean paper and cardboard should go with recyclable dry waste where accepted.

challenges.title: Travel Greener
challenges.question: For a short trip, which option can help reduce transport emissions?

options.text: Drive alone every time
Walk or cycle when safe and practical
Keep the engine running while parked

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Walking or cycling for short trips can reduce emissions.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Consider walking or cycling for short trips when it is safe and practical.

challenges.title: Breathe Cleaner
challenges.question: When local air pollution is high, what is a sensible precaution?

options.text: Exercise beside heavy traffic
Burn leaves to clear the garden
Reduce strenuous outdoor activity

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Reducing strenuous outdoor activity can lower pollution exposure.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. When pollution is high, reduce strenuous outdoor activity and follow local health guidance.

challenges.title: Choose Reusables
challenges.question: Which habit helps reduce disposable packaging?

options.text: Carry a reusable shopping bag
Take a new bag for every item
Choose extra packaging when possible

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Reusable bags can reduce the need for single-use bags.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Carry a reusable shopping bag to help reduce disposable packaging.

challenges.title: Switch Off
challenges.question: What should you do with lights in an empty room?

options.text: Leave them on all day
Switch them off when not needed
Turn on every light in the house

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Switching off unused lights saves electricity.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Switch off lights when they are not needed.

challenges.title: Compost Food Scraps
challenges.question: Which item is commonly suitable for a home compost bin?

options.text: A plastic wrapper
A battery
Fruit and vegetable scraps

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Many fruit and vegetable scraps can be composted.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Fruit and vegetable scraps are commonly compostable; keep plastics and batteries out.

challenges.title: Use Water Wisely
challenges.question: What is a good first step if you notice a leaking tap?

options.text: Report or repair the leak promptly
Ignore it for a month
Open it further

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Fixing leaks promptly helps prevent water loss.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Report or repair leaking taps promptly to reduce water waste.

challenges.title: Protect Green Spaces
challenges.question: What is a responsible way to enjoy a park?

options.text: Leave litter under a tree
Take your rubbish to the proper bin
Damage plants to make a path

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Dispose of rubbish properly and help keep parks clean.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Put rubbish in the proper bin and avoid damaging plants.

challenges.title: Recycle E-Waste Safely
challenges.question: What should you do with an old battery or electronic device?

options.text: Throw it into any street bin
Burn it with household waste
Use an authorised e-waste collection point

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Authorised collection helps e-waste get handled safely.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Take batteries and electronics to an appropriate authorised collection point.

challenges.title: Keep Indoor Air Cleaner
challenges.question: Which action can help reduce indoor air pollution?

options.text: Avoid burning waste indoors and ensure suitable ventilation
Burn plastic to remove clutter
Use smoky fuels indoors without ventilation

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Avoid burning waste and maintain suitable ventilation.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Never burn plastic indoors; avoid smoky fuels and ensure suitable ventilation.

challenges.title: Make Every Trip Count
challenges.question: If several errands are nearby, what can help lower your travel impact?

options.text: Make a separate car trip for every errand
Combine errands into one trip
Let the vehicle idle between errands

challenges.correctFeedback: Correct! Combining errands can reduce unnecessary travel.
challenges.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. Combining nearby errands can reduce unnecessary trips and emissions.

games.title: Tower of Hanoi

games.title: Flappy Bird
games.description: Tap or press Space to fly through the gaps without hitting a pipe.
